_help: Settings for the sendMail action. The bot POSTs 'payload' as JSON to 'url' (your Frappe whitelisted method). Leave 'url' empty to only save payloads to data/outbox.jsonl. Placeholders: {{to}} {{subject}} {{message}} {{reply_to}} from the node's params, {{user_phone}}, and any saved value like {{contact_name}} or {{question}}. Empty values are left out. API key/secret go in .env (FRAPPE_API_KEY, FRAPPE_API_SECRET). Changes apply on the next mail; no restart needed.
